on_actions.label: on_actions hooks
on_actions.description: Hook file with on_startup + on_monthly effect skeletons (additive merge).

game_rules.label: Game rule
game_rules.description: A two-option Game Rules row for the New Game screen (additive merge).

ai_strategy.label: AI strategy
ai_strategy.description: AI strategy block gated on a country tag (additive merge).

gfx_sprite.label: GFX sprite
gfx_sprite.description: Sprite fragment mapping GFX_'<key>' to a texture file (ship the image separately).

frontendgamesetup_slotsize.label: Bookmark slot-size fix
frontendgamesetup_slotsize.description: Scaffold override of frontendgamesetupview.gui that fixes multi-bookmark visibility in total-conversion base mods.

defines.label: Defines tweaks (Lua)
defines.description: Override individual NDefines engine constants in Lua (never copy 00_defines.lua).

bop.label: Balance of power
bop.description: A two-side balance-of-power bar with ranges and mild modifiers; activate it with set_power_balance.

music.label: Music station songs
music.description: Paired .asset + .txt files add songs to the base_music station; upload the .ogg separately.

peace_conference.label: Peace conference cost modifier
peace_conference.description: A peace-action cost modifier row (ships as a 1.0 no-op; additive merge).
